image_description: A full-body shot of a large, dark greyish-green iguana resting on a paved or gravel surface. The iguana is positioned diagonally with its head raised and facing right. It features a prominent dorsal crest running down its spine, a long striped tail extending to the left, and visible limbs. The background consists of blurred green foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular and robust. A distinct fold of skin (dewlap) is visible under the chin/jaw area, consistent with iguana anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the eye socket is visible, the resolution and lighting angle obscure the specific details of the pupil shape and iris color. It is not possible to definitively confirm 'golden irises' or 'round pupils' without speculation.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The side of the head is visible, but the specific scale pattern around the ear region (tympanum) lacks the resolution to identify the specific 'subtympanic shield' feature reliably.
The torso appears thick and muscular, fitting the description of a robust body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana exhibits a dark greyish-green coloration typical of adults. Distinct dark banding is clearly visible on the tail and faintly on the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very prominent, serrated dorsal crest runs continuously from the neck down the spine. This is a defining feature and is clearly present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture of the skin shows clear granularity on the body and larger, smoother-looking plates on the head/face area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front right limb is clearly visible, showing muscular structure and long toes with claws. The rear limb is partially visible and consistent with this anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visibly long (extending beyond the frame relative to body length) and shows the characteristic lateral compression (flatness) and banding.
